description: Work out customer (logo) churn and retention, and revenue churn, gross and net revenue retention for one period, with each formula shown worked. Send the customer count at the start, the count at the end and the new customers won during the period; optionally the recurring revenue at the start and the revenue lost to churn, lost to downgrades and gained from upgrades of those starting customers, and the period length (month, quarter or year) to get the yearly equivalent. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/churn-rate-calc). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

customers_end.description: Customers at the end of the period.

customers_new.description: New customers won during the period (included in customers_end if they are still customers).

customers_start.description: Customers at the start of the period (at least 1).

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'Q3 2026' (your own text, echoed).

period.description: Optional: the length of the period, to add the yearly equivalent (compounded).

revenue_churned.description: Revenue lost from starting customers who left (send with revenue_start).

revenue_contraction.description: Revenue lost from starting customers who stayed but paid less (downgrades).

revenue_expansion.description: Revenue gained from starting customers who paid more (upgrades, add-ons). Not new customers.

revenue_start.description: Optional: recurring revenue at the start of the period (e.g. MRR), from the starting customers.

name: churn_rate_calc
title: Churn and Retention Rate
